breakthroughs.title: RAGE 9 PSIN Binary PSO Decoder — LSCH Schemas, LENM Enums & Instance Values
breakthroughs.summary: Cracked the complete RAGE 9 PSIN IFF container (PSIN + LSCH + LENM + LSNS + LGID + LRSC + CHKS) across 701/701 files in script.rpf, 2,154 in story000_script.rpf, and 1,773+ in data.rpf, decoding typed fields (bool, ints, f32, vec3, JOAAT hashes, arrays, enums) into structured output.
details: PSIN: 16-byte (struct_hash, byte_size) table terminated by 0x70*8 (pppppppp), followed by 16-byte-aligned instance payloads.
LSCH: 32-byte struct headers (0xAA*8 marker, size, field_count = nfields >> 16) + 16-byte field descriptors (name_hash, offset, type_raw, ref_hash).
LENM: 24-byte enum headers (0xEE*8 marker, value_count) + 16-byte (i64 value, name_hash) entries.

breakthroughs.title: Xbox Series X core_bvh4.rpf (8.30 GB) Cracked — RDNA2 Hardware Raytracing BVH4 BLAS
breakthroughs.summary: Identified core_bvh4.rpf (8.30 GB, 1,286 entries) and XboxBvhBuilder.dll (RehydrateRaytracingAccelerationStructureX) as pre-built AMD RDNA2 Hardware Raytracing Bottom-Level Acceleration Structures (BLAS), decoding the 208-byte virtual header, 3D float32 AABBs (p+0x110..0x128), primitive count arrays, and RDNA2 box32/box16 node pointers.
details: Virtual chunk (208 B): +0x20 -> 0x60000000 physical BVH4 BLAS, +0xA0 -> exact BLAS byte size (e.g. 0x8300 = 33,536 B).

Physical buffer: +0x110..+0x128 stores exact 3D float32 AABB bounds (e.g. [-4.464, -1.711, -1.884] to [+4.539, +1.117, +2.345]); +0x640..+0x1100 stores parent/geometry tables; +0x4A00+ stores leaf primitive counts; +0x7900+ stores RDNA2 node pointers ((off >> 3) | node_type).
Cross-verified against XboxBvhBuilder.dll exports (RehydrateRaytracingAccelerationStructureBatched2X, Set64BitMortonCodes).

breakthroughs.title: RPF9 (9FPR) 64-Byte Header Layout & Static-Key TOC Cipher Proven
breakthroughs.summary: Mapped the 64-byte 9FPR header across all 22 archives (data_offset at +0x04, toc_size at +0x08, names_len at +0x0C, entry_count at +0x24) and proved the encrypted TOC (7.998 bits/byte) uses a static key + fixed IV because +0x40..+0x60 (32 bytes) is byte-for-byte identical across four distinct archives.
details: 9FPR Header: +0x00 '9FPR', +0x04 u32 data_offset (exact payload start, e.g. 0x340 in story000_bvh4.rpf), +0x08 u32 toc_size, +0x0C u32 names_len, +0x18 0x47a00, +0x1C 0x150, +0x24 u32 entry_count (4 in story000_bvh4, 418 in common.rpf).

Cross-archive proof: story000_bvh4.rpf, core_licenses_data.rpf, appdata0.rpf, and nested core_licenses_data[0x1000] all share the exact 32-byte ciphertext 5f08daabecbdd40258c3516807024c24fb9f756755ef4be458785bfed8aa6989 at +0x40..+0x60 despite distinct +0x10 archive hashes.
PercyStar now parses 9FPR entry_count and skips directly to data_offset (+0x04) when scanning unencrypted streams.

breakthroughs.title: Xbox Series X PS\x00\x09 PSO Cache Cracked + Native AMD RDNA2 (GFX10.3) → HLSL / SPIR-V Lifter
breakthroughs.summary: Reverse-engineered the entire 274.16 MB uncompressed PS\x00\x09 PSO cache (driver 930.048.020) to the single byte: 25,471 Graphics PSOs (0x70B), 2,693 Compute PSOs (0x18B), 54,576 metadata blobs, and 21,522 raw unencrypted AMD GFX10.3 (RDNA2) shaders — then built a pure-Rust GFX10.3 disassembler + HLSL SM 6.6 / SPIR-V 1.5 lifter inside PercyStar v1.3.0.
details: Exact PS\x00\x09 layout: Header (0x80) -> Gfx PSOs (25,471*0x70) -> Compute PSOs (2,693*0x18) -> Meta Index (54,576*8) -> Shader Index (21,522*8) -> 31.12 MB Meta Blob -> 240.89 MB raw GFX10.3 code.

Confirmed 100% standard AMD GFX10.3 (Mesa RADV/ACO gfx1030) ISA with zero custom opcodes: 12B NSA image_sample_l, Wave32 VOP2/VOP3, s_clause, s_endpgm (0xBF810000), s_code_end (0xBF9F0000), NGG/Meshlet exp prim, and hardware raytracing image_bvh64_intersect_ray.
Decoded 0x41 USER_DATA root-signature binding records (SRV 0x300, CBV 0x302, UAV 0x303, Sampler 0x002), 0x42 register slots, 0x43 128-bit shader hashes, and COMPUTE_PGM_RSRC1/2 + [numthreads(x,y,z)].

Initial v1.3.0 raw opcode-heuristic stage split across 21,522 shaders (9,580 CS, 7,463 PS, 3,574 NGG, 703 VS, 202 RT) — superseded by the v1.3.6 PS09+PSO metadata pass above (9,535 PS, 1,343 VS, 3,082 CS, 7,498 NGG, 64 RT).
PercyStar v1.3.0 adds a dedicated Shaders (RDNA2) tab + --disasm-shaders CLI exporting .asm, lifted HLSL SM 6.6, and valid binary SPIR-V 1.5 (.spv).

breakthroughs.title: Xbox Series X (Scarlett / RDNA2) 4KB & 64KB Deswizzle Equations
breakthroughs.summary: Exhaustively solved and visually verified exact AMD GFX10/RDNA2 SW_4KB_D and 64KB TTPF tile Morton bit permutations for all 5 element sizes (8bpp, 16bpp, 32bpp, 64bpp, 128bpp) plus reverse-mip mip0 tail layout.
details: 32bpp (4B): x0,x1,y0,y1,x2,y2,y3,x3,y4,x4,(y5,x5,y6,x6) — verified on 1024x1024 RGBA8 surfaces
16bpp (2B): x0,x1,x2,y0,y1,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4,x5,(y5,x6,y6,x7) — verified on R16_FLOAT surfaces
8bpp (1B): y0,y1,y2,x1,x0,x2,y3,x3,x4,y4,x5,y5,(x6,y6,x7,y7) — verified on 1024x1024 R8 VFX sheets
Multi-mip surfaces store mipmaps smallest-to-largest; mip0 sits at alloc_end - padded_mip0_size.

breakthroughs.title: RDS5 Virtual Offset & Hardware BCPack Codec Bitfield
breakthroughs.summary: Decoded every bit of the 8-byte RDS5 chunk table entry (lo, hi): exact 4KB-aligned virtual stream offsets without sequential inflation plus exact per-chunk codec flags.
details: Compressed end: (lo & 0x03FFFFFF) * 0x100; Virtual end: (hi & 0x000FFFFF) * 0x4000 + (lo >> 30) * 0x1000.
Codec field (lo >> 26) & 0xF describes the next chunk: 0=RAW, 1..7=Xbox Hardware BCPack (BC1..BC7), 8=ZLIB.
Across all 57 .ttpf databases (1,026,890 chunks / 151.57 GB virtual): 89.42% (134.77 GB) is plain ZLIB; 10.57% uses Xbox Series X ASIC BCPack.

breakthroughs.title: Pure-Rust ADAT Opus Audio Banks & 558 Bink2 Video Streams
breakthroughs.summary: Audited all 22 RPF9 containers: indexed 71,880+ ADAT Opus audio banks, 558 Bink2 (KB2) video streams up to 2560x1440, and 2,525 named animation clip dictionaries.

558 Bink2 videos cataloged across movies.rpf (276), story000.rpf (264), core_restofworld.rpf (11), and story000_restofworld.rpf (7).

rpfOverview: RPF9 (magic 9FPR) encrypts its outer archive directory (TOC / path table), so raw carved resources do not come with outer folder paths. However, most payload blocks inside (ADAT Opus audio, KB2 Bink2 video, PS\x00\x09 RDNA2 shaders, CNavMesh tiles, RBF0/GFx UI, 0DRPz text, TXDs, XML configs, and meshlet geometry) sit in plain zlib or uncompressed streams.
